reason: Both are building-products manufacturers selling roofing and insulation to the construction trade. Carlisle focuses on commercial single-ply membranes, polyiso, spray foam and weatherproofing. Owens Corning focuses on residential asphalt shingles, fiberglass insulation, doors and glass-fiber materials. The offerings and customer bases overlap but are not the same, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
